title: Sales Executive
pay: £27,000 basic, £50,000+ OTE uncapped + company car (guaranteed £3,333 first month)
fit: On your doorstep in Bedford and they want previous sales experience 'whether in automotive or another fast-paced, customer-facing environment' – your Curve Media sales counts. Strong £27k basic plus a 3-day sales course.
desc: Guide customers from first enquiry to handover at Marshall Land Rover Bedford: build relationships, understand needs and recommend new or used vehicles plus finance and insurance products (non-advised). Includes a bespoke 3-day sales training course. Wants good communication and rapport skills, comfort with targets and previous sales experience in automotive or another fast-paced customer-facing role. Full-time, 40 hours, Monday to Saturday with Sundays on a rota; 25 days' leave plus bank holidays, pension and staff discounts.
cover:
Hi Marshall recruitment team,

I'd like to apply for the Sales Executive role at Marshall Land Rover Bedford. My CV is attached.

I work at BCA in Bedford, handling dealership drop-offs and collections, MOT and service movements, vehicle preparation and customer handovers, often on premium cars including Range Rover, Jaguar, Porsche and Bentley.

Before that I spent over a year in sales at Curve Media, finding my own leads by cold calling and email and closing premium promotional packages with business owners and sports and music representatives. I haven't sold cars yet, but building rapport, following up and closing is what I did every day, and I'm comfortable working to targets.

Your sales training course is exactly what I need to start my car sales career locally in Bedford.

Kind regards,
Rougier Williams
07407 433797
prep:
30-SECOND PITCH
I work at BCA in Bedford with dealerships every day – drop-offs, MOT and service movements, handovers – often on premium cars like Range Rover and Jaguar. Before that I sold premium advertising packages at Curve Media from cold calls and emails. I haven't sold cars yet, but I can build rapport, follow up and close, and I want to learn properly with Marshall.

LIKELY QUESTIONS
• Why car sales, why Land Rover? You love premium cars from BCA and want a long-term sales career.
• Tell me about a sale you closed. Pick a real Curve Media deal: how you found them, the objection, how you closed.
• How do you handle targets and rejection? Cold calling at Curve Media – persistence and running your own pipeline.
• How would you follow up a customer who went quiet after a test drive? Call, recap what they liked, offer next step.
• What do you know about finance products? Be honest: basics of PCP/HP, keen to learn on the course.
• Saturdays and Sunday rota? Say yes if you can.

ASK THEM
• What does the 3-day course and first three months look like?
• How are leads shared, and what do new starters typically earn in year one?

RESEARCH
Defender, Discovery, Range Rover Sport and Velar ranges; Marshall Motor Group (part of Constellation); the Bedford site on Clapham Road area (MK41).
